visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white t-shirt pours two bottles of chocolate milk into a large metal pot containing a king crab, several shrimp, and various mushrooms and vegetables. The scene is set in a living room with a gray sofa. (2) A young boy in a white and green school uniform stands on the sofa behind the man. The man points to the hot pot while talking excitedly, and the boy nods vigorously and starts dancing. (3) The scene shifts to the hot pot boiling on a portable gas stove. The man lifts the glass lid, and steam billows out. He reacts with wide eyes and an open mouth. (4) The man uses a ladle to pour the chocolate-colored broth into a small floral bowl. He tastes the soup and gestures with a thumbs-up while looking at the camera. (5) Using metal tongs, the man lifts a large, red crab leg from the pot. He shows the meaty inside of the leg to the camera. (6) The young boy is seen eating a piece of crab meat. He looks delighted and performs a 'crab dance' on the sofa. (7) The man continues to eat various ingredients from the pot, including shrimp, mushrooms, and Chinese cabbage, reacting positively after each bite. (8) The setting transitions to a kitchen with white cabinets. The man pours white sugar and water into a black wok, then turns on the gas stove. (9) He adds chunks of roasted sweet potato to the bubbling sugar syrup, coating them thoroughly. (10) He picks up a coated potato with tongs and dips it into a glass bowl filled with ice water to harden the sugar. (11) The man eats the candied sweet potato, showcasing its crunchy exterior. (12) Finally, he stands in the kitchen holding bottles of chocolate milk and bags of sweet potatoes, pointing at them while delivering a closing message.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative promotion for ZES PROTEIN hazelnut chocolate milk and 7-11 sweet potatoes. It uses a shock-value food experiment (chocolate milk hot pot) to grab attention, followed by a legitimate candied potato recipe to demonstrate product versatility, all delivered with high energy and humor.
